title: Magical Cusco
short_description: Cusco - Sacred Valley - Ollantaytambo - Machu Picchu - Rainbow Mountain - Humantay Lake
long_description: Welcome to the historic capital of the Inca Empire! Cusco awaits you with its ancient charm, historic streets and some of the most impressive landscapes in Peru. During this journey, you'll visit iconic destinations such as the Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, Rainbow Mountain and Humantay Lake—an ideal mix of culture, nature and adventure.
price_note: Includes transportation, entrance tickets and professional guide.
seo_title: Magical Cusco 5D/4N – Machu Picchu, Humantay Lake & Rainbow Mountain | GT Peru Travel
seo_description: Magical Cusco 5-day tour: Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, Humantay Lake and Rainbow Mountain. Full package with transportation, entrance tickets and professional guide.

days.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cusco & City Tour
days.text: Airport pickup and transfer to your hotel. In the afternoon, enjoy the City Tour visiting Sacsayhuamán, Qenqo, Puka Pukara and Tambomachay. Free evening for acclimatization.

days.title: Day 2: Sacred Valley – Train to Aguas Calientes
days.text: Visit the Sacred Valley of the Incas: Pisac, artisan market, Taray viewpoint and the Ollantaytambo fortress. In the afternoon, train ride to Aguas Calientes. Overnight stay.

days.title: Day 3: Machu Picchu Tour
days.text: Early entrance to Machu Picchu to explore the Inca citadel with a professional guide. Free time for photos and exploration. Afternoon return to Cusco.

days.title: Day 4: Humantay Lake
days.text: Excursion to Humantay Lake with a moderate hike. Enjoy the turquoise waters and glacier landscapes. Return to Cusco in the afternoon.

days.title: Day 5: Rainbow Mountain & Departure
days.text: Hike to the famous Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca), one of the most stunning natural landscapes in Peru. Afternoon transfer to the airport for your departure flight.
